benefits.effect: Julie Farkas will give the player character the Followers lab coat and a key to the Followers safehouse, providing they have completed High Times and donated enough chems to fill one supply need.
Arcade Gannon can become the player character's companion.
Arcade Gannon will refuse to be the player character's companion.
The Brotherhood of Steel will give the player character a key to the Brotherhood of Steel safehouse.

They will replenish an ammunition crate next to Ramos' room with random energy weapons ammunition every three days if one has a positive reputation. This coincides with the completion of Still in the Dark (for either side).

Veronica will refuse to be one's companion.
Brotherhood night patrols will be hostile and attack the player.
Lucius will give a key to the Caesar's Legion Safehouse.
Lucius will teach the player character the special Legion Assault Unarmed move with an Unarmed skill of 50 or higher.
Required to complete the quest I Put a Spell on You in favor of the Legion.
Required to help Silus escape from Camp McCarran.
Boone and Arcade Gannon will refuse to be the player character's companion.
The Legion will also provide various items within boxes outside of Cottonwood Cove; for more information, see the quests Caesar's Hire and Caesar's Favor.
The unmarked quest Caesar's Foe will occur: Legionary assassins will be sent to kill the player character throughout the wasteland.
Beware the Wrath of Caesar! will fail, permanently locking out the Legion main questline with all faction members becoming enemies of the player character.
Required to complete Diane's tasks in Aba Daba Honeymoon, unless the player character is wearing Khan faction armor when they speak to her.
Required to be named Papa Khan's heir after completion of We Are Legion.
Allows the player character to convince the mercenaries in Unfriendly Persuasion to leave without fighting if they do not pay them off or have high Speech.
James Hsu will give the player character a key to the NCR Ranger safehouse.
Allows the player character to ride the monorail without the NCR becoming hostile if one does not wear NCR faction armor.
Allows the player character to convince each camp in No, Not Much to send reinforcements to Bitter Springs without completing their quests.
Allows one access to Silus during Silus Treatment.
An NCR Ranger will give the player character the NCR emergency radio.
Allows access into HELIOS One without high Speech, Science or Sneak.
Required along with a Speech of 50 to trade with Bardon in Hoover Dam if one does not follow the NCR main quest line up to Colonel Moore.

The unmarked quest Most Wanted will occur: NCR Ranger hit squads will warn the player character to change their reputation with NCR within three days, or they will come after them to kill the player character throughout the wasteland. If Vilified, they will be immediately hostile.

Don't Tread on the Bear! will fail, permanently locking out the NCR main questline with all faction members becoming enemies of the player character. (The quest can fail in other ways but this will happen if it fails due to low reputation.)
Cass and Boone will refuse to be the player character's companion.
Powder gang merchants will sell to the player character with 1-to-1 exchange rate.

Eddie will give the player character one stick of dynamite, four pistol powders and four rifle powders every three days.
